meta.title: Taboo deck for fluent non-native English speakers (American English)
rules: The guess word itself and all its inflections/compounds are automatically forbidden and are not listed.
Each card lists five extra forbidden words: the one-word definition, the category, the main function or collocation, a strong synonym, and (where one exists) the obvious opposite.
Vocabulary is deliberately culture-neutral: no national sports, brands, holidays, celebrities, idioms or region-specific foods.
Spelling and vocabulary are American (COLOR, THEATER, TIRE, PANTS, FAUCET); British variants are equally forbidden.
